_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 6 object handlers: objects $3D, $3E, $65 and the address getter ($BDBC-$BFD0). The generators subtract these.

TYPE $3D (A STAGE BUILDING THAT FIRES SPREADS): first frame?
regions.description: TYPE $3D (A STAGE BUILDING THAT FIRES SPREADS): Type bit 7 set goes to `$BDE2`. Table stats: collision flags `$7A`, hit points 64, attack 128, drawing flags 0, **dies as type 7 (the 42-frame player-side explosion)**, art 0. A ground object made from stage metatiles; **no area scaling**. Like `$38`, `$39` and `$3A` its timings depend on the scroll; the run fed a fixed step of 1 px a frame.
